content: कारित {%a.%} Caused to be done or effected. .{@-ता@} Interest, the amount of which is fixed by the debtor (being forced to do so by the creditor). .{@-तम्@} The causal form of a verb. कारितार्थ causal sense शेत्यर्थः कारितार्थो वा निर्देशोऽयं समीक्षितः <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls>P. V. 3. 55</ls>.
